shortDescription: Delete the objects that make up the licensed program(product)

options.name: become_user
options.description: The name of the user profile that the IBM i task will run under. Use this option to set a user with desired privileges to run the task.

options.name: become_user_password
options.description: Use this option to set the password of the user specified in C(become_user).

options.name: joblog
options.description: If set to C(true), output the available JOBLOG even the rc is 0(success).

options.name: language
options.description: Specifies which national language version (NLV) objects are deleted for the licensed program specified on the LICPGM parameter. It's the IBM-supplied language feature codes, like German is 2924, English is 2924.

options.name: option
options.description: Specifies which of the parts of the licensed program specified on the Product prompt (LICPGM parameter) are deleted.

options.name: product
options.description: Specifies the seven-character identifier of the licensed program that is deleted.

options.name: release
options.description: Specifies which version, release, and modification level of the licensed program is deleted.
